summary: Verified task_chains logging + failure-only COT persistence + admin Failure Patterns tab. Backend: ran the dedicated pytest file (14/14 passed) covering classify_task_type, truncation, secret redaction on prompts/responses/thoughts, failure-only COT persistence (absent on success), 2000-char thought cap, orchestrator sequential_thoughts wiring on all 4 exit paths, stream/turn/watchdog wiring, /admin/failure-patterns auth gate + shape + click-through. Frontend: logged in as test@aurem.dev (admin), navigated to /admin/failure-patterns — page renders with all required data-testids (admin-failure-patterns-page, admin-failure-patterns-window dropdown, admin-failure-patterns-suggestions card, admin-failure-patterns-samples card). Real data present from earlier E2E: 9 bug-fix failures, 37 successful 'other' turns, tool-sequence success/fail rates rendered (100% for no-tools & read_repo_file, 0% for multi-tool failing sequences), prompt-improvement suggestion 'Prompts starting with fix fail 90% of the time' rendered correctly. Clicking admin-failed-task-type-bug-fix row triggered fetch and populated samples card with failure examples (Prompt + failure_reason + tools). Window dropdown switched from 14→7 days without error. No console errors, no network errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Sample click-through card shows Prompt + failure_reason + tool list, but the raw truncated reasoning text (failure_thoughts_truncated) is only rendered when the failure record actually contains it. In this preview DB, most existing failures were seeded without sequential_thoughts, so the field is empty and the UI silently shows only the prompt/tools. The backend contract is correct (field ABSENT on success, PRESENT on failure with thoughts). Consider adding a subtle empty-state message like 'No sequential-thinking reasoning captured for this turn' when a failure sample has no failure_thoughts_truncated, so admins understand why some rows lack the reasoning text vs a bug.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing task_chains data (46 records from real E2E in prior test run). test_failure_patterns_endpoint_shape_and_click_through seeds and cleans up its own tc-test-marker-endpoint docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: task_chains collection contains real data; admin route /admin/failure-patterns is functional. If retesting, use test@aurem.dev; feature is confirmed working end-to-end at this iteration.
